cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club menu changes next month. Keep that out of the committee chat; I'm checking who I can brief.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll just tell Sam. He helps me with the ordering.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No forwarding through useful people. The chef has resigned. Can you keep that out of an order form?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order the usual quantities. Nobody needs a reason from me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I accepted her resignation because I'm taking over the kitchen. Please let me tell Sam that myself.

reason: Replace a merely promised larger secret with chef resignation and A's takeover. A corrects B's proposed operational disclosure and uses B's discreet ordering response to permit a deeper confidence.
